description: Personal and employee data stays on this laptop. Every service binds to 127.0.0.1 only, no AI or speech provider outside the machine is allowed, and federated identity providers that would send identity data to Google or Microsoft stay disabled. checks/check-data-locality.mjs enforces these rules against the four project repositories without printing any secret values.

principles.description: Personal data (employee, profile, resume, device and conversation data) is stored and processed only on this laptop.
Every listening service binds to 127.0.0.1 or localhost. Nothing is exposed on a LAN or public interface by this configuration.
AI inference uses local providers only: Ollama on loopback and the JARVIS gateway on loopback. Paid or cloud AI is off.
Identity federation with external providers (Google, Microsoft, other social IdPs) is disabled. Login is local to the ASAA realm with TOTP MFA.

AI_PROVIDER must be ollama or jarvis; OLLAMA_URL and JARVIS_AI_URL must point to a loopback host
